entities.title: free-disk-space
entities.summary: The free-disk-space crate: one command-line binary that reclaims disk space on a Mac (APFS) by cleanups, a resumable compression scan, verified in-place compression, clone dedupe and an optional background daemon.
entities.purpose: Holds the crate's manifest (Cargo.toml), its README for the people who install and use it, and its code in src/. It builds one binary, free-disk-space, in the Cargo workspace macos/rust; the binary installs its own launchd login item when asked.
boundaries: Release packaging is not here: the universal macOS binary, the zazzle-macos-universal.tar.gz release tarball and the one zazzle Homebrew formula (published to the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, installing this binary with the toolbox's others) are made by .github/workflows/release.yml and macos/release/formula.sh.
The zazzle invoker in macos/c/zazzle/ is a second way in: `zazzle free-disk-space ARGS` replaces itself with this binary, found beside it, so the program and its output are the same.
The agent skill that tells coding agents how to use the binary is agents/skills/free-disk-space/SKILL.md.
It is one independent utility of the toolbox; it shares no code with the other tools.
